## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run build --workspaces` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a failing test first for bug fixes)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, `docs/`, TSDoc) where behaviour changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and carry a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING)
